purpose: Hymn of praise (stotra) to various Buddhas and Bodhisattvas engraved on the four sides of a chaitya
notes: No historical human persons (donors, kings, or scribes) are mentioned in this preserved portion of the inscription; it consists entirely of devotional verses dedicated to Akṣobhya, Samantabhadra, Śākyamuni, Vajradhara, Buddha Samantakusuma, Mañjuśrī, Susthitamati, Amitābha, Lokeśa, and Mahāsthāmaprāpta.
